description: Paths panel commands: rename, duplicate or delete a path; select or deselect it (Path Selection); load it as a selection (Make Selection); make a work path from the selection (Make Work Path); make it the clipping path; fill or stroke it on the active layer; save it as a custom shape preset (Edit > Define Custom Shape); or show/hide the Paths panel

antiAlias.description: make_selection and fill: anti-aliased edges. Default true

color.description: fill: colour. Default: the foreground colour

combine.description: make_selection: how it combines with the current selection. Default replace

feather.description: make_selection and fill: feather radius in pixels. Default 0

flatness.description: make_clipping_path: flatness in device pixels. Default: the printer's

newName.description: rename: the new name; duplicate: the copy's name; define_custom_shape: the preset name

path.description: Path name, as in the Paths panel (list_paths)

pathIndex.description: Path index from list_paths, instead of its name

preserveTransparency.description: fill: leave transparent pixels transparent. Default false

simulatePressure.description: stroke: taper the stroke as pen pressure would. Default false

tolerance.description: make_work_path: tolerance in pixels (lower follows the selection more closely). Default 2

tool.description: stroke: the painting tool, with its current settings. Default brush

name: manage_paths
title: Manage Paths
